verdict.rationale: Paddle is a billing platform that ships SDKs, Paddle.js, and MCP servers, so asking whether telemetry or usage tracking can be disabled is a fair question for a product of this kind. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, for the SDKs, Paddle.js, the MCP servers, or the dashboard. With no evidence for an applicable capability, the verdict is none.
